'''K7-1EG''', known as "'''Wuniji'''," was a [[Service droid|server droid]] who worked at the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] in [[Point Ueda]] on the [[planet]] [[Ueda]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], the [[droid]] carried [[menbachi bowl]]s through the shop before pausing to re-estimate the [[Diet|appetite]] of patron [[Kesmer Faloodi]].

==Biography==
[[File:K7-1EGPatrons-LostFound.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=In the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop, the alien patrons Bihun, Basko, and Kesmer Faloodi sit around a table slurping noodles as K7-1EG hovers past. In the background a hooded Mae-ho Aniseya enters the shop.|K7-1EG worked at the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop.]]
K7-1EG, also known as "Wuniji," was a [[Service droid|server droid]] cobbled together from kitchen appliances and pieces from other [[droid]]s. During the [[High Republic Era]], K7-1EG worked at the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]], a venue in [[Point Ueda]], [[capital]] of the [[planet]] [[Ueda]]. The cranky droid was overworked and undermaintained at the [[noodle]] shop, where the churlish regulars made many cruel jokes about K7-1EG.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> the droid was carrying a pair<ref name="Lost Found">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> of heat-resistant [[menbachi bowl]]s<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> through the middle of the noodle shop as the [[Sith assassin|assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] entered the building in [[Mae's quest|search]] of [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]]. As Aniseya passed the droid, K7-1EG paused beside<ref name="Lost Found" /> the notoriously gluttonous patron [[Kesmer Faloodi]] so that the droid's [[processor]]s could calculate and recheck estimates for his [[Diet|appetite]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> Aniseya then confronted and attacked Indara, [[Indara's murder|killing]] her after most patrons had fled from the shop.<ref name="Lost Found" />

==Characteristics==
K7-1EG hovered using internal [[repulsorlift]]s that could carry the server's bronze-[[color]]ed cast [[iron]] frame, which included a dome-shaped body with a red [[sensor]] at the front and a four-fingered [[Limb|arm]] on each side.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
K7-1EG first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="Lost Found" /> the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 4]], [[2024]], on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The scenes in the shop were filmed at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> Prior to the release of the show, the droid was revealed in a trailer for ''The Acolyte'' released on [[March 19]], 2024.<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|BtytYWhg2mc|The Acolyte | Official Trailer | Disney+}}</ref> The character was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> [[Industrial Light & Magic]] production visual effects supervisor<ref name="Julian Foddy" /> [[Julian Foddy]] created a custom render of K7-1EG for the ''Visual Guide''.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
